stories.title: BMC seeks nod to pay Rs 3.2cr metro cess to clear path for textile museum in Mazgaon
stories.summary: The payment is to be made to the Mumbai city collector’s office for the cess applicable on the land transfer document. 34-sqm mill to BMC on Jan 7, 2009, under Regulation 58 of Development Control Rules, 1991, for its development as a recreation ground. In Dec 2016, the state urban development department (UDD) directed that 44,000sqm of the land be reserved for a recreation ground and a textile museum.

stories.title: Eight rescued, firefighter injured in fire at south Mumbai residential building
stories.summary: Eight people, including two children, were rescued after a fire broke out at a four-storey residential building in south Mumbai in the early hours of Sunday. A firefighter sustained injuries during the rescue operation, officials said. 07 am at Hira Manzil, located on Gildar Lane near Navjivan Society in Mumbai Central.

stories.title: Mumbai local train update: Mega block on central, Harbour and Western Railway lines today; services to be affected
stories.summary: 10pm. 58pm will run on the slow corridor till Thane before being re-diverted to the fast line at Mulund. 40 pm. 35pm on Sunday for maintenance of tracks, signalling and overhead equipment. Slow trains will run on fast lines during the block.

stories.title: Viral video shows minors assaulting man and woman at Kurla garden
stories.summary: A group of minors allegedly assaulted a young man and a woman at a public garden in the eastern suburb of Kurla in Mumbai. A video of the incident has also gone viral on social media, police said on Saturday. An official said that the attack took place at Pramod Mahajan Garden behind a mall in Kurla West, as per PTI.

stories.title: BMC scraps underground passage below Mahalaxmi Racecourse, ₹702-crore Metro-Coastal Road link to be redesigned
stories.summary: Amid opposition from architects and urban planners to Mahalaxmi Racecourse’s proposed redevelopment as part of the big-ticket Central Park project, BMC has decided to scrap all underground construction below the iconic landmark. The link, which was originally planned to pass beneath the racecourse, will now run entirely above ground adjoining the walking pathway of the racecourse stretch.

stories.title: Thief breaks into St Andrew’s Church, steals ₹15,000 in donation money
stories.summary: A thief broke into St Andrew’s Church in Bandra (west) and stole the cash from five donation boxes, leaving the local community shaken. According to the First Information Report (FIR) filed by parish priest Father Nigel Barrett, the theft took place between 11 pm on Friday and 5 am on Saturday after the burglar broke open a window and gained entry to the church.

stories.title: Bombay HC Allows Chembur Society Redevelopment, Says Members Cannot Be Made To Wait Over 15-Year-Old Dispute
stories.summary: (Representative Image) Mumbai: Observing that members of a Chembur housing society have been left in the lurch for nearly 15 years after vacating their homes for redevelopment, the Bombay High Court has said they cannot be made to wait indefinitely for the outcome of prolonged legal proceedings.

stories.title: BMC To Replace 400 Damaged Manhole Covers Across Mumbai At ₹1.10 Crore
stories.summary: 10 Crore | File Pic Mumbai: With broken, missing and damaged manhole covers posing a serious threat to pedestrians and motorists, the BMC has moved to replace covers on 400 manholes across Mumbai at an estimated cost of Rs. 10 crore. The move comes amid growing concerns over public safety and the risks posed by uncovered or damaged manholes on the city's roads and footpaths.

stories.title: BMC Clears Mobile High-Mast Lights For Deonar Dumping Amid Corporators' Questions Over Availability, Cost Hike
stories.summary: With Deonar’s biomining and Waste-to-Energy projects yet to become operational, the BMC has approved vehicle-mounted high-mast lights to facilitate night-time dumping operations. However, the proposal came under fire at the recent Standing Committee meeting, with corporators questioning the equipment’s actual availability, necessity and a steep hike in contractor rates.

stories.title: Mumbai Police to issue cards with QR code for identity checks
stories.summary: Mumbai Police will issue cards with QR code and NFC to personnel, and citizens can scan the code through the Mumbai Police Citizen App to check a person’s photograph, name, date of joining and posting, a measure that follows cases in which fraudsters posed as police and sought money from citizens.

stories.title: Six sent to juvenile home after Mumbai assault; Maharashtra SP leader seeks age change
stories.summary: A juvenile court ordered that six persons in the 12- to 15-year-old age group be placed in a juvenile home until December 4, after Ghatkopar police detained eight persons below 18 in connection with an assault on a couple at Pramod Mahajan Garden in Kurla on Friday evening (November 20, 2026) and produced all eight before the Juvenile Justice Board, police said.

stories.title: Video call helped reassure family of four stranded on third floor of Mumbai Central building during midnight fire; eight rescued
stories.summary: A video call helped reassure a family of four, including two children, stranded on the upper floor of a three-storey building in Mumbai Central as fire raged below them shortly after midnight on Sunday. 07am. Fire brigade personnel, officers, a turntable ladder, an ambulance and other equipment were deployed.

stories.title: Relief for over 3,000 flat buyers as National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission holds developer of Mumbai project guilty of deficiency in service for decade-long delay in possession
stories.summary: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC) has held the developer of D B Ozone project in Dahisar guilty of deficiency in service and unfair trade practice over delayed possession, failure to provide promised amenities and other alleged violations, offering relief to more than 3,300 homebuyers waiting for over a decade.The developer, Neelkamal Realtors Suburban, has filed a special leave petition in Supreme Court even as the buyers filed a caveat before the apex court after…

stories.title: Mumbai Railway News: MRVC Adopts Advanced Soil Strengthening Technology To Expedite Borivali–Virar 5th And
stories.summary: Mumbai: In a move aimed at speeding up the long-pending expansion of Mumbai's suburban railway network, the Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation (MRVC) has introduced a specialised ground improvement technology to strengthen soft soil along the Dahisar–Mira Road stretch of the Borivali–Virar 5th and 6th line project.

stories.title: 67-year-old disabled man assaulted by four in Mumbai
stories.summary: 40 pm outside the complainant Yakub Ishaq Deoria’s house at Second Wadi. He alleged that Salim Min grabbed his neck and pushed him onto a two-wheeler, injuring his spine. When his daughter-in-law and grandsons intervened, they were allegedly assaulted by Salim, Ayaz and Sahil Min. Deoria was taken to Sion Hospital, where doctors diagnosed a spinal fracture.

stories.title: Western Railway motormen, train managers participate in WNC Navy Half Marathon
stories.summary: Train managers and motormen from Western Railway participated in the WNC Navy Half Marathon 2026 in Mumbai on Sunday, November 22, completing the 5 km and 10 km running categories. The railway employees took part in the event despite their demanding operational schedules, which involve ensuring the safe movement of trains throughout the year.

stories.title: AIFF president Kalyan Chaubey calls for ‘mutual accountability’, says former officials should share reports of their tenures
stories.summary: AIFF president Kalyan Chaubey called for “mutual accountability” amidst growing concerns over Indian football, asking all those who have held positions of responsibility in the ecosystem to share reports of their respective tenures. Chaubey’s remarks came a day after former AIFF president Praful Patel expressed concern over the present state of Indian football.

stories.title: Angry over breakup, Mumbai man pours petrol, sets ex-girlfriend's flat on fire in upscale locality
stories.summary: A youth allegedly set his former girlfriend's flat on fire in Dombivli after she decided to end their seven-year relationship. The accused allegedly poured petrol on the entrance door of the flat, where the woman lived with her parents, and set it ablaze.

stories.title: Temperature in Mumbai drops by about 5 degrees in a day
stories.summary: 2°C at Santacruz on Saturday (November 21, 2026), a drop of about 5 degrees from Friday, ranking second lowest among November temperature readings in the past 10 years. 7 degrees below the average and the lowest so far this winter. Forecasts indicate below-average temperatures in the days ahead.

stories.title: Mumbai weather update: Clear skies forecast as mercury touches 33.2 deg C
stories.summary: 2 degrees Celsius on Sunday, November 22. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast mainly clear skies across Mumbai and its suburbs on Sunday, November 22, with no significant change in weather conditions expected. 8 degrees Celsius in Colaba. 30 am on Sunday.

stories.title: Mumbai Navy Half Marathon draws over 22,000 runners from India and abroad
stories.summary: More than 22,000 runners, including 59 participants from 20 foreign countries, took part in the ninth edition of the Indian Oil WNC Navy Half Marathon 2026, organised by the Indian Navy in Mumbai on Sunday, November 22. The event began at Cross Maidan, with participants competing in three categories: the 21-km Aircraft Carrier Run, the 10-km Destroyer Run and the 5-km Frigate Run.

stories.title: 8 Killed, 2 Injured As Car Rams Tree In Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirapalli
stories.summary: Eight people were killed and two others seriously injured after the car they were travelling in rammed into a neem tree in Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirappalli district on Sunday, police said.The accident occurred around 4.05pm near Kothurpatty Four Roads, within the limits of Jambunathapuram police station.The 10 occupants were returning to Thirukattupalli in Thanjavur district after attending an ear-piercing ceremony at Erumapatti in Namakkal district, police said.Five occupants died on the spot, while three others succumbed…

stories.title: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ramrao Wadkute dies at 72
stories.summary: BJP Rajya Sabha lawmaker Ramrao Wadkute died of a heart attack at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) in New Delhi on Sunday. He was admitted to the hospital after complaining of chest pain. Wadkute, who hailed from Maharashtra’s Hingoli district, was known for his influence among the Dhangar community in the Marathwada region.

stories.title: '90 seats, one crore votes': Revanth Reddy sets Congress' 2028 Telangana target
stories.summary: Telangana chief minister A Revanth Reddy on Sunday expressed confidence that the Congress would return to power in the state by winning 90 of the 119 Assembly seats in the 2028 elections.

stories.title: Bengal BJP MLA Rekha Patra critical after suspected pesticide poisoning
stories.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MLA from Hingalganj in West Bengal’s North 24 Parganas, Rekha Patra, was on Sunday (November 22, 2026) admitted to a private hospital in the city after falling ill from suspected pesticide poisoning. The MLA was admitted to Basirhat Subdivision Hospital, from where she was shifted to the private facility.

stories.title: RJD supporters tear down posters near Nitish Setu inaugurated by PM Modi in Vaishali; 3 held
stories.summary: Hours after Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the six-lane Nitish Setu across the Ganga in Vaishali on Saturday, a group of people identified as Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) supporters created a commotion on the newly inaugurated bridge.

stories.title: YS Sharmila arrives at Bengaluru airport to visit family palace ahead of daughter's wedding, cops stop her
stories.summary: Karnataka police on Sunday prevented Andhra Pradesh Congress president YS Sharmila from proceeding to the disputed family palace in Yelahanka, Bengaluru, citing a court order restraining her from entering the property, people familiar with the development said. Sharmila arrived at Bengaluru airport in the evening along with her mother, YS Vijayamma, her son, Raja Reddy, and daughter-in-law, Priya Atluri.

stories.title: Raut alleges Rs 150 cr per MP to pass Delimitation Bill; BJP responds
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut on Sunday accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of attempting to buy MPs from other political parties to secure the numbers required to pass the proposed Delimitation Bill in Parliament. He alleged that the BJP was offering Rs 150 crore for each MP who switches sides, reported the IANS.

stories.title: 24 civilians killed in fresh South Sudan violence | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: A weekend attack by opposition forces in volatile South Sudan killed 24 civilians, including seven children, local authorities said Sunday. The world's youngest country, which gained independence in 2011, has been torn apart by violence between rival political factions, often linked to ethnicity or cattle rustling.

stories.title: MP: 3 killed, 33 injured as tractor-trolley carrying pilgrims overturns on NH-44
stories.summary: Three people were dead and 33 others were injured after a tractor-trolley carrying villagers overturned near Neem Ghati on National Highway-44 in Sagar district on Sunday afternoon, police said. Deori sub-divisional magistrate (SDM) Munawwar Khan said the victims were residents of Garhaula Gosai village in Bandri tehsil and were returning from Barman.

stories.title: The decade India turned the tide on poverty
stories.summary: A year ago, during my visit to Kiphire, an aspirational district in the remote hills of Nagaland, I interacted with tribal women from local self-help groups. Among them was Esther, a Lakhpati Didi, who proudly spoke of her millet-based products reaching customers online, far beyond Nagaland. I encouraged them to dream bigger and become Crorepati Didis.

stories.title: Maharashtra scales down tree plantation drive amid severe drought, says Fadnavis
stories.summary: Maharashtra has scaled down its tree-plantation drive this year due to acute water shortages caused by severe drought conditions across several districts, Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said on Saturday. Speaking at an event in the presence of spiritual leader Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev, Fadnavis said that 80-90 per cent of rural Maharashtra was facing drought and a severe water crisis.

stories.title: "Anti-Hindu": BJP On Tamil Nadu Government's Deepam Order Review Plea
stories.summary: The BJP on Sunday said the Tamil Nadu government's move to seek a review of a Supreme Court order permitting the lighting of the traditional Karthigai Deepam lamp on November 24 as a one-time measure at Deepathoon reflects an "anti-Hindu and anti-Sanatan Dharma" mindset of the Congress and its allies.

stories.title: Centre prioritising border villages, 40 seeing reverse migration: Amit Shah in Arunachal Pradesh
stories.summary: Describing the development of border villages as a priority of the government, Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Sunday (November 22, 2026) said the upliftment of about 40 villages along the International Border in Arunachal Pradesh , under the Centre’s flagship Vibrant Villages Programme (VVP), ensured that many of those who moved out from these areas were returning.

stories.title: Manipur hooch tragedy toll rises to 17; sample sent to Kolkata lab
stories.summary: The death toll in Manipur’s hooch tragedy rose to 17 on Sunday (November 22, 2026), as the State government sent samples of the suspected spurious liquor produced locally to the National Food Laboratory in Kolkata for testing. Government spokesperson and MLA Thokchom Radheshyam Singh said 16 people who died after consuming the liquor were from Chandel district and one was from Kakching district.

stories.title: Hyderabad Police issue alert over terror threat email; security checks conducted at key locations
stories.summary: The Hyderabad Police issued a precautionary alert following a reported terror threat warning of possible bomb blasts at two locations in the city, including Hotel Tourist Plaza in Kacheguda and Kacheguda Railway Station. The sender also threatened to replicate the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks in Hyderabad. A senior police official told The Hindu that the message appeared to be a hoax.

stories.title: Indian opposition party’s youth wing warns of more Meta protests after police clashes
stories.summary: The youth wing of India’s main opposition Congress party warned of more protests against Meta’s removal of some of its members’ ⁠accounts, ⁠a day after clashing with ​police outside the tech firm’s locals offices.

stories.title: Maharashtra to upgrade 3,832 anganwadis with smart classrooms, modern kitchens
stories.summary: Maharashtra will upgrade 3,832 anganwadi centres across the state under a government initiative to improve infrastructure and provide children with better learning facilities, Women and Child Development Minister Aditi Tatkare said on Sunday. The centres will be equipped with e-learning tools, rainwater harvesting systems, modern kitchens and other facilities as part of the plan to develop them into smart anganwadis.

stories.title: Kasimedu fisherfolk withdraw strike after Minister’s intervention
stories.summary: Fishermen of Kasimedu on Sunday withdrew their indefinite strike, seeking the release of eight boats impounded by the Andhra Pradesh government, after the intervention of Finance Minister N. Marie Wilson, who is also the MLA for Dr. Radhakrishnan Nagar Assembly constituency. The Minister, who reached the fishing harbour on Sunday morning, interacted with the leaders of various associations, and listened to their grievances for about an hour.

stories.title: Go public or stay private: Tata Sons gears up for decision this week
stories.summary: Tata Sons is heading into one of its most consequential weeks in decades. The six-member board is already divided, with Trusts chairman Noel Tata, a director of Tata Sons, opposed to an IPO while the other five directors favour compliance with RBI's listing requirement.

stories.title: Eight killed as speeding minivan rams into roadside tree in Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirappalli
stories.summary: Eight people were killed and two others injured after a minivan lost control and rammed into a roadside tree in Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirappalli district on Sunday, police said. The incident took place at around 4 pm in Musiri, which is located about 350 km south of Chennai, an officer said.

stories.title: 2 Army soldiers killed after tank runs over them during training exercise in Haryana
stories.summary: Investigating Officer Ashok Kundu said Hisar Police received information about the accident while the military exercise was underway at the training centre. Providing details of the incident, Kundu said, "Information was received around 3:00 PM that a military exercise was underway at the Army training center in Bhojraj village.

stories.title: ‘Haven’t invited me to discuss Indus waters’: Pak minister Musadik Malik evades questions on IWT, ‘cut off hands’ remark
stories.summary: Pakistan minister Musadik Masood Malik said that Pakistan would discuss the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) only when formally invited to do so, deflecting questions on the issue from reporters in Delhi. Malik also dodged questions about his earlier controversial “cut off hands” remark, avoiding a direct response to the matter.

stories.title: Yuzvendra Chahal joins BJP as OBC Morcha member, thanks PM Modi, other leaders for a ‘place in the family’
stories.summary: Cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Saturday after being named a special invitee to its OBC (Other Backward Classes) Morcha's national working committee. The BJP on Saturday released its list of national office-bearers, national executive members and other appointments in the party's OBC Morcha, which also included the name of Chahal.

stories.title: After 1,000 years of slavery, 50 crore lifted out of poverty in 13 years: PM Modi
stories.summary: Addressing Gujarat BJP workers virtually at a post-Diwali Sneh Milan, PM Modi took an apparent swipe at the Opposition, saying some people were reluctant to acknowledge the decline because it had happened under his government. “Whether they like it or not, we are satisfied that the results of our work are visible.

stories.title: Delhi's Tanjot Singh wins INSPIRE award for wool-and-cotton HEPA alternative
stories.summary: Tanjot Singh from Delhi Public School developed an innovative air filtration system using compressed wool felt and electrostatic cotton. His project aimed to provide a sustainable alternative to synthetic HEPA filters commonly used for air purification. Tanjot initiated this project under the INSPIRE-MANAK programme, gaining recognition for its environmental benefits.

stories.title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' $325M stadium investment fuels NWSL title success
stories.summary: Kansas City Current's first NWSL Championship rewarded its owners' long-term investment in women's soccer infrastructure. Patrick and Brittany Mahomes were part of the ownership group that backed the club's purpose-built stadium and training facility. Angie Long said the facilities gave the team a sense of permanence and relevance.

stories.title: 'The Hunger Games' scores huge USD 120 million opening
stories.summary: Sunrise on the Reaping premiered successfully, grossing USD 120 million in North America over the weekend. This latest installment marks a resurgence for the franchise that had seen declining interest. The film featured a new cast while retaining beloved characters like Haymitch Abernathy. It appealed particularly to younger audiences, with a significant box office turnaround attributed to Gen Z.

stories.title: Raza Murad lauds SRK's unmatched energy on set
stories.summary: Veteran actor Raza Murad has praised Shah Rukh Khan's energy on set, calling him a "human dynamo" and wondering how he stays so lively despite reportedly smoking 80 cigarettes a day. Murad also named Ranveer Singh as the next superstar of this generation. Meanwhile, SRK will next be seen in 'King', releasing December 24, 2026.

stories.title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
stories.summary: An explosion has occurred on a Russian ship docked at Benghazi naval base port after a suspected drone attack, Libya's eastern government has said. The explosion happened at dawn on Sunday, while the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia, Libyan state media reported, citing the eastern government.

stories.title: COP31 talks fail as EU, others reject any climate deal without language on a fossil fuel phase-out
stories.summary: A standoff on a fossil fuel phase-out prevented countries at COP 31, the United Nations climate talks in Antalya, Turkiye, from achieving any consensus agreement on future climate action on Sunday (November 22, 2026), despite the conference running a record 48 hours into overtime. The European Union led objections to COP 31 President Murat Kurum’s consensus cover text that failed to include any explicit language about moving away from fossil fuels.

stories.title: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat
stories.summary: The Democratic Party has won the largest majority in the US House of Representatives since 1992, after Democrat Chuck Hubbard unseated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina. The race was called on Sunday, with Hubbard beating Foxx by 330 votes with 99% counted. It was one of the closest contests of the recent midterm elections, in which Democrats also secured the Senate.

stories.title: FSSAI orders prosecution against Bisleri International for unsafe packaged drinking water
stories.summary: Food regulator FSSAI on Sunday (November 22, 2026) said it has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International, as it found its sample of packaged drinking water "unsafe". In a social media post, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said it has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd regarding "unsafe packaged drinking water".

stories.title: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
stories.summary: Italian jeweller Paolo Bulgari, who helped turn his family's business into a global luxury brand, has died in Rome aged age 89. His family announced the news, remembering him as "the greatest jeweller of our time", according to Italian media. Paolo Bulgari was Chairman of the Bvlgari Group since 1984 and its jewellery pieces have adorned Hollywood stars and royalty including Diana, Princess of Wales.

stories.title: Netanyahu, Eisenkot parties end talks without deal on forming Israel government
stories.summary: The parties of caretaker Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his rival Gadi Eisenkot concluded a new round of talks on Sunday (November 22, 2026) without reaching an agreement on a possible coalition government, which would require concessions from both sides. Delegations from Eisenkot's Yashar party and Netanyahu's Likud met for four hours at a hotel in Herzliya, near Tel Aviv, following a first round of discussions last Sunday (November 22).

stories.title: Alcaraz charges past world number one Zverev to clinch ATP Finals title
stories.summary: Seven-time Grand Slam champion Carlos Alcaraz powered past world number one ​Alexander Zverev 6-2 7-6(7) on Sunday (November 22, 2026) to win his maiden ATP Finals ⁠title. S. Open after a four-month break due to a wrist injury, saved three set points in the tiebreak before completing his 14th consecutive victory and ending ‌the year with a third straight title, having also triumphed in Vienna and Paris.

stories.title: Injured Jacks out of T20 Australia tour
stories.summary: England all-rounder Will Jacks has been ruled out of the rest of the tour of Australia with a broken hand. The 28-year-old was injured after four balls of the penultimate over as Australia took victory in the first T20 international in Melbourne on Saturday. Jacks was hurt trying to take a caught-and-bowled chance off Ben Dwarshuis.

stories.title: States agree to UN talks aiming to regulate 'killer robots' by 2028
stories.summary: ⁠UN talks on regulating weapons with little or no human oversight ended on Saturday (November 21, 2026) with a pledge for further discussions to develop new rules within two years, ‌an outcome weakened by Russia's opposition and disappointing human rights groups. Proponents had called for legally binding rules within ‌a short timeframe to regulate weapons systems that can identify and engage ‌targets ⁠with varying degrees of autonomy, sometimes called "killer robots".

stories.title: Liverpool hammer ten-man United in Pochettino debut
stories.summary: The scale of Mauricio Pochettino's rebuilding ​job was laid bare on Sunday (November 22, 2026) as ‌Manchester United crashed to a 4-0 ​Premier League defeat at ⁠Liverpool, their first match under the Argentine unravelling within minutes. Reduced to 10 men after eight ‌minutes, United fell two goals behind within 13 and never ‌recovered as Liverpool cruised to ‌victory ⁠through goals from Dominik Szoboszlai, Florian ⁠Wirtz, teenager Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz.

stories.title: Marquez wins record-equalling eighth MotoGP title
stories.summary: Marc Marquez clinched a record-equalling eighth MotoGP championship with an eighth-placed finish in the Portuguese Grand Prix on Sunday. The Spaniard needed to finish in the top nine on his Ducati to seal a second consecutive championship and move level with legendary Italian Giacomo Agostini on eight titles.

stories.title: Key UN Climate Talks That Ended In Deadlock Or Failure
stories.summary: The failure of COP31 climate talks in Antalya is the latest in a string of disappointments at major UN environmental summits since the first Conference of the Parties, or COP, in 1995. Various previous summits have descended into acrimony or even failed completely over a lack of consensus.

stories.title: Harshit turns up the heat against Pakistan, gives Hussain an aggressive send-off
stories.summary: With emotions running high between the arch-rivals, Rana was involved in a few heated exchanges with Pakistan's opening batters during his bowling spell. Pakistan got off to a flying start after opting to bat first, with Shamyl Hussain and Maaz Sadaqat putting India's bowling attack under pressure. Harshit Rana's fiery send-off to Shamyl HussainThe breakthrough eventually came through Ayush Badoni, who dismissed Hussain to end the opening partnership.

stories.title: US Intelligence Chief Says Putin Is 'Not America's Friend In Ukraine'
stories.summary: ""He is not America's friend in Ukraine. Trump later defended his remarks, arguing that "it's nice to have people that have 4,000 nuclear weapons as a friend as opposed to an enemy." "The Russia-Ukraine war began in February 2022 and Moscow currently controls about a fifth of its neighbouring country's territory.

stories.title: South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal
stories.summary: South Korea's Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin has resigned over an exam cheating scandal that shocked the nation. He said he took full responsibility for the confusion caused by last-minute measures aimed at stopping AI-assisted cheating during Thursday's annual college entrance exam, known as Suneung. A week ago, the top scorer in the national tax accountancy exam admitted using a mini-camera, mobile phone and AI tools.

stories.title: Second ship targeted in series of naval drone attacks off Libyan coast
stories.summary: A second attack has been reported on a commercial vessel flying a Maltese flag off Benghazi. Libyan forces reportedly intercepted more than 20 naval drones. This follows a drone attack earlier in the day against a Russian ship docked at a Benghazi naval base in eastern Libya.

stories.title: Broncos' legend and ESPN broadcaster Tom Jackson recently underwent back surgery; ex-teammate calls death ‘unexpected’
stories.summary: Tom Jackson, a Denver Broncos legend who earned fame as a broadcaster with ESPN after his playing career ended, has passed away. Chris Berman, Jackson's longtime broadcasting partner at ESPN, announced the news of his death Sunday morning on ESPN. According to NBC affiliate News 9, Tom Jackson died unexpectedly in Ohio on the evening of November 20, Friday.

stories.title: Balen Shah India visit highlights: ‘India cherishes special friendship with Nepal,’ says Jaishankar on meeting Nepal PM
stories.summary: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah met external affairs minister S Jaishankar. Nepalese Prime Minister Balen Shah arrived in New Delhi on Sunday evening on his maiden official visit to India after taking charge in March. A traditional folk performance added a cultural touch to Shah's welcome in India, with Uttarakhand artists presenting the region's indigenous Tandi dance, also known as the Jaunsari song and dance.

stories.title: ‘Disappointing’: Delegates react after COP31 climate talks end without deal
stories.summary: google Add Al Jazeera on United Nations climate talks have failed to secure a deal on how to deal with climate change, prompting UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres to express “a very profound frustration”.

stories.title: COP31 president says climate deal ‘not approved’; EU claims oil states ‘hijacked’ talks | World News
stories.summary: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey ended without an agreement on Sunday after countries failed to reach a consensus on the proposed climate deal, with summit president Murat Kurum confirming that the decisions had not been adopted. The European Union, which opposed the final draft over its failure to explicitly mention fossil fuels, accused oil-producing nations of having “hijacked” the talks.

stories.title: Bahrain says Iranian attack caused fire at industrial facility
stories.summary: google Add Al Jazeera on | Updated: 20 minutes ago Updated: 20 minutes ago Bahrain has said an Iranian attack on a civilian industrial facility caused a fire, as Iran’s Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said it targeted US air defence radars in the Gulf country.

stories.title: ‘Two rulers, one fort’: Pakistan Minister invokes Humayun, Sher Shah at SCO Civilisational Forum
stories.summary: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik, in his address at the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi, invoked Mughal Emperor Humayun and Sher Shah Suri, both associated with the construction of the Purana Qila, and said the old fortress is in itself a story of multiple layers of history.

stories.title: Nepal PM Balen Shah Begins First India Visit, Talks With PM Modi Tomorrow
stories.summary: Nepal PM Balendra Shah Begins First India Visit, Meets EAM Jaishankar; To Hold Talks With PM Narendra Modi On Nov 23 | X @DrSJaishankar New Delhi: External Affairs Minister (EAM) S Jaishankar on Sunday met Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah, who is on a two-day state visit to India.

stories.title: Bangladesh unrest: Bengal CM Suvendu to write to EAM to extend minority entry cut-off
stories.summary: West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari on Sunday said he would contact external affairs minister S Jaishankar on Monday to convey concerns in the state over the escalating violence in Bangladesh. Suvendu said the developments in Bangladesh were "extremely painful" and had caused widespread concern in West Bengal, where many people have relatives across the border.

stories.title: Trump threatens fresh strikes on Iran after New Year if talks fail
stories.summary: In an interview with Fox News on Sunday, Trump said Iranian negotiators were more aggressive than before the US elections and dismissed their approach to diplomacy as meaningless. Trump also warned Iran against challenging the US naval blockade of its ports, saying American forces would respond forcefully if Iranian vessels attempted to breach it.

The United Nations climate change conference in Turkiye has failed to reach an agreement. Countries in the greatest danger, and the European Union, refused to accept the final text – with deep disputes over fossil fuels.

stories.title: How long is a new Fitbit actually supposed to last?
stories.summary: Preferred Source Google Discover Longevity is a major factor to consider with any fitness wearable . It's meant to be used 24/7, and its subject to conditions that would wreck many other products, from accidental knocks and scrapes to heavy deadlift sessions. As gadgets go, there are few things worse than discovering you're out a few hundred dollars because your tracker wasn't sufficiently sweatproof.

stories.title: What the little clock icon at the top of your Samsung phone means
stories.summary: Three different icons can pass for a clock on your Galaxy phone, and each one has an easy fix. Framesira/Shutterstock : Preferred Source Google Discover You're fiddling on your phone and that bar at the top of your screen is peppered with various icons. There's your battery level, the Wi-Fi icon, the signal bars — but what's that tiny clock doing there?

stories.title: COP31 ends without a deal: Why talks collapsed and what was left undone | HT Explainers
stories.summary: COP31, the United Nations ’ annual climate summit, ended without a deal in Antalya on Sunday, after the European Union, the UK and several climate-vulnerable countries rejected the final text, leaving the questions of fossil fuels and climate finance unresolved. At the closing plenary on Sunday afternoon, COP31 president Murat Kurum, who is also Turkey’s environment minister, told countries the proposed Antalya pact did not have consensus.

stories.title: Bisleri water sample fails FSSAI test: What did inspectors find? What action was taken? What we know
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has approved prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd after a sample of its packaged drinking water was declared unsafe. The food safety regulator said the sample did not meet the prescribed limits for bromate. It was also found to contain polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) during further testing at a referral laboratory.

stories.title: GTA 6 story explained: Who are Jason and Lucia, and what role do they play in the world of Grand Theft Auto
stories.summary: The story of Grand Theft Auto VI centres on two main characters, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Set in the fictional state of Leonida, the game follows the pair as they become involved in a criminal conspiracy after a job goes wrong. The latest instalment in the popular Rockstar Games series takes players back to Vice City, a fictional version of Miami.

stories.title: Can we build a more ethical AI future?
stories.summary: play video Video Duration 25 minutes 00 seconds play-arrow 25:00 Marc Lamont Hill speaks with tech entrepreneur Anil Dash about AI’s risks and the fight for ethical technology. The artificial intelligence boom is transforming the global economy and concentrating enormous power in the hands of a few technology companies.

stories.title: Everyday explained: What is déjà vu?
stories.summary: Déjà vu feels eerie, like memory playing a trick on the conscious mind. Here is the likely explanation for why almost all humans experience this. Everyone has experienced déjà vu at some point in their lives, often more than once.

stories.title: Prime-number puzzle & fluid equations: The two math problems claimed to be solved with AI | HT Explainers
stories.summary: Researchers said on Friday that artificial intelligence (AI) had helped them crack two problems that have defeated mathematicians for generations: the Riemann hypothesis, about prime numbers, and a central question about the Navier-Stokes equations , which describe how fluids move. Mathematicians are divided over what such proofs are worth when a computer has checked them but no person has read them in full.

stories.title: Why are so many more young Scots claiming disability benefits?
stories.summary: Scotland political correspondent Published 1 minute ago Every month, more than 12,000 applications are made to Social Security Scotland for disability support. The number of Scots receiving these benefits has risen sharply since the Covid pandemic, and is projected to hit one million by the end of the decade.

stories.title: Carbon capture is a key flashpoint at COP31. Why it is contested & how it differs from CO2 removal | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The inclusion of carbon capture, a technology that traps carbon dioxide at factory and power-plant chimneys, in a proposed COP31 climate deal that doesn’t mention fossil fuels has become a flashpoint, which critics say would help polluters go on burning.

stories.title: Is Your Wedding Gold Really Pure? CTI Flags Shocking Adulteration Risks, ₹6 Lakh Crore Marriage Market Faces Trust Crisis
stories.summary: With Tulsi Vivah marking the start of the wedding season , nearly 52 lakh marriages are expected nationwide, generating business worth approximately ₹6 lakh crore. Delhi-NCR alone could witness around 5 lakh weddings, contributing nearly ₹1 lakh crore in business. Gold jewellery purchases traditionally account for a significant portion of wedding expenditure.

stories.title: Is Nostalgia The Next Big Industry? How Brands Are Turning Old Memories Into New Business
stories.summary: There is something interesting happening in the world of brands and consumer behaviour: a growing fascination with the past. Consider Apple's latest Diwali campaign, Step Into the Light, created with Indian fashion label Raw Mango. Instead of a contemporary chartbuster or an original composition, the technology giant turned to a familiar 1990s melody, Roop Suhana Lagta Hai, composed by Anu Malik for the 1994 film The Gentleman.

stories.title: Why Engineering students need to know what to do when the machine doesn’t work
stories.summary: A cross UG Engineering laboratories in India, practical coursework is built to confirm known results, not to investigate unknown ones. Instruments are calibrated before students arrive. Test rigs use components chosen because they behave. The lab manual is a checklist that terminates at an answer already printed in the syllabus.

stories.title: Three cyclones in three weeks: What’s happening in the Bay of Bengal? | Explained
stories.summary: Within 23 days this year, three cyclones formed over the Bay of Bengal. Of them, Cyclone Arnab made landfall near Yanam on the Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28 and Murasu on November 3 near Ongole. Cyclone Akvan formed on November 16 and made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha on Friday morning (November 20, 2026).

stories.title: Who is Team USA’s fifth Survivor Series pick? Trick Williams named after smackdown twist
stories.summary: Trick Williams has officially secured his spot as the fifth member of Team USA for the upcoming Survivor Series: WarGames. His inclusion was negotiated by Cody Rhodes and CM Punk, amidst discussions involving other candidates like Hacksaw Jim Duggan. In his prior match against Damian Priest, Williams emerged victorious by disqualification due to a ring bell attack.

stories.title: Charlie Puth to make India debut with Ellie Goulding at Mumbai music festival in February 2027
stories.summary: American singer Charlie Puth is set to make his India debut alongside British singer Ellie Goulding at the inaugural Johnnie & Co. Festival in Mumbai on February 13, 2027. The one-day event will be held at the Mahalaxmi Racecourse and is expected to attract more than 35,000 attendees.

stories.title: Sonu Nigam turns Raipur-Mumbai flight into mini concert after passengers sing his hit songs | See video
stories.summary: Singer Sonu Nigam had an unexpected musical evening while travelling from Raipur to Mumbai, after fellow passengers turned his routine flight into a singalong featuring some of his most popular songs. The singer, who was touched by the gesture, decided to return the favour with a performance of his own.

stories.title: From entire towers to entire floors, Mumbai investors drive big-ticket property deals | Real Estate News
stories.summary: An emerging trend in Mumbai’s luxury property market is seeing ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNIs) move beyond buying individual apartments or office units to acquiring entire residential towers and commercial floors. While one buyer may be looking for the privacy and exclusivity of a private mansion, another may see an entire office floor as a long-term investment, a future workplace or a source of rental income.

stories.title: Colleges, BMC schools turn to Mumbai Book Festival to pull Gen Z away from doomscrolling
stories.summary: Next week, Gen Z and Gen Alpha students of the city will gather at the University of Mumbai’s Kalina campus to read books, explore literature and listen to writers, historians and other well-known personalities. With students spending an increasing amount of time on mobile phones and social media, colleges and schools are using the Mumbai Book Festival as an opportunity to bring them closer to physical books and encourage reading beyond classrooms.

stories.title: Francesca Tandoi makes India debut at Mumbai International Jazz Festival: I love the saree, the culture | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: On Friday, the city witnessed the balmy notes of global jazz at the NCPA International Jazz Festival. Opening the show, Italian pianist and vocalist made her India debut as she took to the stage with her trio, comprising Stefano Senni on double bass and Pasquale Fiore on drums, at the National Centre for the Performing Arts (NCPA).

stories.title: Mumbai International Crime Festival brings together actors, authors, filmmakers, investigators and survivors to explore crime through literature and cinema
stories.summary: ound for crime literature, cinema and real-life experiences as the inaugural Mumbai International Crime Festival brought together storytellers, survivors, investigators, actors, writers and filmmakers for two days of discussions on crime, criminals and their portrayal on screen.

stories.title: Mumbai This Weekend: From A Bhakti Concert To A Classic Car Rally, 5 Events To Check Out
stories.summary: Looking for plans in Mumbai this weekend? From an immersive musical experience and a vintage car showcase to a stand-up comedy show and a heritage walk, the city has something for everyone. Whether you want to explore Mumbai's history, enjoy live entertainment or catch a sporting event, here are five activities to add to your weekend itinerary.

stories.title: Mumbai Book Festival to begin on November 24 at University of Mumbai’s Kalina campus
stories.summary: The National Book Trust (NBT) and the Maharashtra government have organised the 'Mumbai Book Festival' starting on November 24 to 29 with the aim of improving the reading culture among people of all age groups . The festival venue will be the University of Mumbai's Kalina campus in Santacruz.

stories.title: ‘Home-sick’: Mumbai exhibition explores Himalayan medicinal plants and disappearing habitats
stories.summary: By definition, homesickness refers to the unhappiness one experiences when away from home for an extended period. However, for Garima Gupta, an artist and researcher based in New Delhi, the term takes on a more layered meaning. Through her exhibition Home-sick, currently on view at TARQ, Gupta considers sickness as both a symptom and a witness — a condition through which stories of exhaustion, displacement and care become perceptible.

stories.title: ‘You are as good as your last performance’: Looking back on 50 years of Mumbai theatre group Ank
stories.summary: At Ank’s studio in Mumbai’s Laxmi Industrial Estate, Preeta Mathur Thakur is preparing understudies for Veera Rani Abbakka , the production the theatre group is performing to celebrate its golden anniversary year. An actor calls to say he is stuck in traffic and will be late for rehearsal.

stories.title: Ananya Panday, Simone Ashley, Anna Wintour to Sara Tendulkar: Celebs serve major fashion inspiration in glamorous looks at Mumbai event | Fashion Trends
stories.summary: Last night was nothing short of glamorous as a host of celebrities descended upon Mumbai for the Vogue India Forces of Fashion 2026 Preview on November 18. The star-studded guest list included Ananya Panday, Mrunal Thakur, Sobhita Dhulipala, Sara Tendulkar, Simone Ashley and Anna Wintour, among others.

stories.title: Panvel To Host Over 100 Theatre Groups For 13th Atal Karandak Competition, Promising Grand Celebration Of
stories.summary: The competition, which has completed 12 editions, will begin with preliminary rounds on November 21 at various centres across Maharashtra. The large participation includes theatre organisations and college teams, offering a platform for budding actors, writers and directors to showcase their talent.

stories.title: World Press Photos Down To Earth Exhibition Makes India Debut In Mumbai
stories.summary: Organised by World Press Photo in partnership with the Consulate General of the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Mumbai Press Club, the exhibition brings together 21 award-winning photographic projects. Through powerful visual storytelling, it explores the environmental challenges shaping the planet, and also draws attention to communities, ideas and movements working towards a more sustainable future.

stories.title: Rs 4,000 for an Avengers ticket. Mumbai goes big on Doomsday with added shows
stories.summary: The film has also crossed Rs 10 crore in opening-day advance bookings, with about one lakh tickets sold across PVR INOX and Cinepolis within 19 hours of bookings opening. Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, the film is scheduled to release in India on December 17, a day before its US theatrical debut.

stories.title: Mumbai art scene: Two exhibitions explore playful chaos and the human figure
stories.summary: For Radhika Simoes Kapoor, art does not have to be philosophical. “ Art is fun ,” shares the Art Institute of Chicago alumna. Today, she will open her first show in almost a decade, Collective Chaos, which features works of mixed media that capture spontaneous chaos and, of course, fun.

stories.title: Things to Do in Mumbai This Week | November 16–22, 2026
stories.summary: By entering your email address you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy and consent to receive emails from Time Out about news, events, offers and partner promotions. A definitive guide to all the best things happening in Mumbai this week, from music gigs to food experiences.

stories.title: BMC drops underground development at Mahalaxmi Racecourse
stories.summary: The civic administration has decided to scrap the ambitious underground component of the reimagined Mahalaxmi Racecourse plan, signalling a victory for urban planners and architects advocating for the city of Mumbai. While overground landscaped gardens and recreational spaces will remain part of the plan, Olympic-level sports facilities and a massive parking bay, which were to occupy two underground levels, have been dropped.

stories.title: MP’s Ujjain Khade Hanuman Temple Idol Scanned Again Amid Simhastha 2028 Preparations, Fears Of Removal Grow
stories.summary: FP photo Ujjain (Madhya Pradesh): Amid preparations for Simhastha-2028, fresh activity surrounding the idol at the Khade Hanuman Temple has once again raised concerns. A team from outside the city arrived at the temple and carried out scanning around the idol using technical equipment for one hour.

stories.title: Bandi Sanjay inaugurates solar power system at Karimnagar gurudwara, lauds Sikh community
stories.summary: Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar on Sunday inaugurated an 11 kV solar panel system installed at the local Gurudwara using MPLADS funds in Karimnagar. Speaking on the occasion, Mr. Sanjay said the Gurudwara had been incurring an electricity bill of approximately ₹25,000 every month, which had become a financial burden on its management.

stories.title: Gwaliors Bhelse Wali Mata Temple: 108 Steps, A Mysterious Idol And A Connection To Chhatrapati Shivaji
stories.summary: VIDEO | Gwalior (Madhya Pradesh): Interestingly, there is a temple in Madhya Pradesh’s Gwalior where the idol of the goddess is believed to have been discovered in a treasure and is made of a special black stone traditionally used to test the purity of gold.

stories.title: Kartik Purnima 2026: Know Correct Date, Shubh Muhurat, Significance, Rituals & More
stories.summary: FPJ In the Hindu calendar, Kartik Purnima is regarded as one of the most auspicious and significant occasions. Observed on the full moon day of the Hindu month of Kartik, the festival holds immense religious importance for devotees of Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva.
